GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (12 Jan 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 588)
12 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of IWAKI (alias IWASHIRO), Takeo.
1. IWAKI, Takeo, a Korean delivered by the Japanese authorities to Tokyo Detention Camp (Sugamo Prison) is being returned to his home in Korea for military reasons.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will alter its records accordingly.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
